mapper.select: select count(1) from comments where article_id = #{articleId}
select count(1) from article_favorites where article_id = #{articleId}

select A.slug articleSlug, A.title articleTitle, A.description articleDescription, count(AF.user_id) as favoriteCount, U.id userId, U.username userUsername, U.bio userBio, U.image userImage from articles A inner join article_favorites AF on A.id = AF.article_id left join users U on U.id = A.user_id where AF.created_at >= datetime('now', '-7 days') group by A.id order by favoriteCount desc limit #{limit}
